note: Calibration of docs/reference/yandex-center.png (Yandex Maps screenshot, 1528x955 px, north up). Local frame: metres, +X east, +Z SOUTH, origin = ORIGIN. See calibration.md.

origin.note: local frame origin (= the ll of the Yandex URL). It is NOT the centre of the screenshot.

originPixel.note: pixel of the screenshot that shows the local origin (0,0)

pxToWorld.description: x = a*u + b*v + c ; z = d*u + e*v + f  (u right, v down, pixels; x east, z south, metres)

worldToPx.description: u = x * pixelsPerMetre + u0 ; v = z * pixelsPerMetre + v0
